name: Flag Day
hint: Touch a flag and that is where anyone who falls comes back.
why4: Three must pile on the pillar plate while the fourth goes in, the 4-block needs four pushers, and three must hold the spring lid open for the fourth.
solution: Everyone jumps the 2-wide pit at x=7-8.

P4 jumps the pillar and goes on to gate A; P3 waits on the step at x=14-15. P2 jumps onto the plate on the 1-wide pillar at x=12 (height 1); P1 jumps onto P2's head; P3 jumps from the step onto P1's head (3/3): gate A at x=20 opens.
P4 walks through A and stands on the inner plate at x=22 (1/1). P3, P1, P2 climb down, walk through A and jump over P4; P4 steps off. Someone touches flag C at x=24.
Conga-push the 4-block (x=30-31) right: P3 against it, P1, P2, P4 behind, until it sits on the plate at x=37-40 (4/4): bridge E over the 6-wide pit at x=44-49 appears.
Everyone jumps over the block, crosses the bridge, touches flag C at x=52 and jumps the 2-wide pit at x=55-56.
P1, P2, P4 stand on the plate at x=59-61 (3/3): lid F over the spring at x=64 opens.
P3 hops onto the spring from x=63 (launched to 5.5), steers right up through the one-way shelf at x=65-67 (height 5; the feet clear it by 0.5), touches the key at x=66 and drops off the right end.
Everyone touches flag C at x=71, takes a running jump over the 3-wide pit at x=75-77, hops the 2-high step at x=81-83, jumps the 2-wide pit at x=86-87; P3 opens the door at x=92; all press Down.
Recovery: a 4-block pushed past the plate falls in the pit and returns to x=30; falls after a flag respawn at that flag.
